result.title: Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TS-Router-D8FF.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 TS-Router，用预训练时序基础模型的表示来估计多个异质异常检测器的相对能力，并为每条目标序列选择适配的专家检测器，从而避免固定统一的异常评分机制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由表示估计各专家胜任度并做 Top-k 路由选择」的机制，可能为 LVR 中根据内部 latent 状态决定调用哪种推理操作或证据筛选策略提供可核查线索；但该工作属时序异常检测领域，与多模态推理只有概念层面的联系。
